A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the symmetric potentials are not only the simplest but also the most interesting potentials for the scalar fields in gauged super-gravities in diverse dimensions.
the symmetric potentials are not only useful to construct the solutions, but also provide an efficient tool to analyze their properties.
all the solutions of the symmetric potentials are stable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the symmetric potentials of the gaugied supergravity models are a useful tool in the construction of asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetimes.
the scalar potentials of diverse supergravities have the same form, which we conjecture to be universal.
the scalar potentials in diverse dimensions are described by the same universal formula, which is a function of a single variable.
